minutes.headline: Commission had only three members, so it could vote only to continue 213 Electric Avenue to March 5; other items were informal.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission met with three members present. It continued the 213 Electric Avenue notice of intent to March 5 and heard a Lake Shirley tree-removal request at 338 Sunset Lane informally, with no vote. 67 Island Road was left off the agenda by oversight and moved to February 19. The office also set a DocuSign signing schedule.

attendees.role: member (applicant on his own request for determination, and recused as abutter on another item)

public_comment.topic: Applicant for 67 Island Road (Melissa) said her materials were submitted on time and asked why the item was not on the agenda; told it must go on the February 19 agenda.

votes.motion: Continue the 213 Electric Avenue notice of intent to March 5, with requests for temporary erosion protection, a revegetation narrative, silt fence as limit of work, and answers to DEP comments in the stormwater plan
votes.outcome: passed 3-0 by roll call (all three voting members said aye)

decisions.decision: 67 Island Road will be placed on the February 19 agenda because it cannot be heard when not on the posted agenda.
32 Hemlock Drive left as is; improperly noticed to abutters, so it must be re-advertised and treated as a fresh first hearing, on a March date.

338 Sunset Lane request was informational only, with no vote, because of no quorum; the commission wants a replacement plan for the three shoreline trees and was inclined to accept removal of the peninsula dead trees for safety.
352 Sunset Lane hearing could not be opened for lack of quorum (Jeff recused); continued to February 19.
Commission members to sign DocuSign documents by end of day Tuesday; documents sent out Thursday of the prior week.
No interest in exercising the right of first refusal on 100 Town St Harbor Chapter 61 removal.
Wildland grant and tree policy deferred to a meeting when Chris and Mary are present.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission voted 3-0 by roll call to continue the 213 Electric Avenue notice of intent to March 5, with conditions on erosion protection and stormwater answers.
A request to remove trees at 338 Sunset Lane on Lake Shirley was heard informally with no vote, because the commission lacked a quorum.
The 352 Sunset Lane hearing could not be opened for lack of quorum, with one member recused, and was continued to February 19.
67 Island Road was left off the posted agenda and will be heard on February 19, since an item not on the agenda cannot be heard.
32 Hemlock Drive was improperly noticed to abutters and must be re-advertised as a fresh first hearing in March.

why_it_matters: Applicants and neighbors with projects near wetlands or Lake Shirley faced delays this month, because a commission with too few members cannot take binding votes on them.
Notice errors, such as a missed abutter notice or an item left off the agenda, restart or postpone a hearing, so abutters should check posted agendas for the new dates.
